hotspots.name: Kyiv
hotspots.title: Strikes on Kyiv bridges during German chancellor's visit
hotspots.summary: Russia struck a key bridge in Kyiv as Chancellor Merz arrived on 4 Oct, the second bridge hit in two days. Moscow has pledged heavier strikes after Kyiv said it will keep targeting Russian refineries.

hotspots.name: Odesa
hotspots.title: Black Sea shipping under fire
hotspots.summary: Russian attacks on civilian cargo ships around Odesa have in effect blockaded Ukraine's Black Sea ports, cutting grain and steel exports.

hotspots.name: Berdychiv
hotspots.title: Apartment strike; bus hit at Moldova border
hotspots.summary: A residential block in Berdychiv was damaged across six floors and a passenger bus was struck at the Ukraine–Moldova border. ISW expects early strikes on the power grid ahead of winter.

hotspots.name: Volga refinery belt
hotspots.title: Ukraine's long-range refinery campaign
hotspots.summary: Ukraine's defence ministry says more than half of Russia's oil refineries have now been hit, and Kyiv says the campaign will intensify.

hotspots.name: Tehran
hotspots.title: US–Israeli war on Iran, month eight
hotspots.summary: The war that began on 28 Feb 2026 has no settlement in sight. Tehran says there is no military solution; former diplomats expect escalation in the coming weeks. Around 9,000 more US troops are heading to the region.

hotspots.name: Strait of Hormuz
hotspots.title: Hormuz shipping crisis
hotspots.summary: Explosions reported in the strait, probably Iranian fire on ships, while a US blockade and new sanctions squeeze shipping lanes. Regional crude exports have still recovered above pre-war levels.

hotspots.name: Aden / Gulf of Aden
hotspots.title: Counter-offensive against the Houthis; tanker incident
hotspots.summary: Yemeni government forces have opened a large offensive to retake Houthi-held ground. UKMTO reported explosions near a tanker off the southern coast.

hotspots.name: Southern Lebanon
hotspots.title: Israel–Hezbollah war since 2 March
hotspots.summary: Major fighting resumed when Hezbollah struck Israel after the Iran war began. UNIFIL's mandate expires on 31 Dec 2026.

hotspots.name: Gaza
hotspots.title: Ceasefire plan stalled at phase one
hotspots.summary: A year on, the disarmament and withdrawal phases are unimplemented and the IDF holds roughly half the Strip. Strikes continue. Israel votes on 27 Oct.

hotspots.name: Dubai
hotspots.title: Attempted downing of Israel-bound airliner
hotspots.summary: A flydubai co-pilot tried to crash a flight carrying 180+ people. Israel says he was radicalised; President Trump says he believes Iran was behind it and has threatened strikes if a link is shown.

hotspots.name: RAF Fairford
hotspots.title: US bombers pulled from RAF Fairford
hotspots.summary: The US withdrew its B-1 bombers from the Gloucestershire base amid reports of an alleged Iranian plot. The UK national threat level is SEVERE.

hotspots.name: North Kordofan
hotspots.title: Sudan: the war moves to Kordofan
hotspots.summary: Since taking El Fasher in Oct 2025 the RSF holds most of western Sudan; El Obeid, Kadugli and Dilling are exposed. Famine conditions persist. (Last confirmed update Jan 2026.)

hotspots.name: Taiwan Strait
hotspots.title: Sustained PLA pressure on Taiwan
hotspots.summary: China held live-fire drills off Dongshan Island in July, a day after US–China talks; median-line crossings continue and Taipei has expanded civil-defence exercises.

hotspots.name: Dhahran
hotspots.title: Global oil stockpiles drawn down
hotspots.summary: Aramco's chief executive warned the crude and fuel squeeze will tighten and refilling emergency stocks could take up to two years. Brent is trading around $100.

hotspots.name: Belgrade
hotspots.title: Parliamentary election on 25 Oct
hotspots.summary: Serbia goes to the polls later this month.

hotspots.name: Madrid
hotspots.title: Spain heads to an early election
hotspots.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announced early elections in a televised address.

cyber.title: Citrix NetScaler: mass exploitation of two RCE flaws
cyber.summary: Citrix confirmed two bugs that let attackers plant code and pivot into networks. Guidance is to assume compromise.

cyber.title: FortiMail zero-day CVE-2026-104286 (CVSS 9.8)
cyber.summary: Fortinet warns the flaw is exploited in the wild for unauthenticated code execution.

cyber.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager auth bypass added to KEV
cyber.summary: CISA lists the flaw as actively exploited.

cyber.title: Apple CoreGraphics CVE-2026-86950: public PoC
cyber.summary: Flaw Apple says may have been used against targeted individuals; researchers see a possible delivery path via PDFs.

cyber.title: Warlock ransomware hits water, telecom and government
cyber.summary: China-linked actor still exploiting SharePoint flaws for initial access and to disable security tools.

cyber.title: Pentagon personnel data breach: 3M+ affected
cyber.summary: Week's largest disclosed breach of personnel records.

cyber.title: Bitget: $387.5M theft via third-party zero-day
cyber.summary: Exchange confirms attackers abused a flaw in a third-party security product.

cyber.title: DIVD breached by an autonomous AI agent
cyber.summary: Dutch vulnerability-disclosure institute confirms a noisy intrusion run by an AI agent.

cyber.title: Operation KillSwitch dismantles KillSec
cyber.summary: Europol-led takedown; a 16-year-old alleged administrator arrested in Spain.

cyber.title: BYOD group leaks Trump Mobile customer data
cyber.summary: About 3,600 records posted to a leak site; access path unconfirmed.

cyber.title: Qilin ransomware hits Japanese electronics maker
cyber.summary: Engineering documents and system designs exposed on a leak site.

notes: Nasdaq closes at a record as tech leads; S&P 500 within 0.3% of its summer high.
US Treasury yields remain near multi-decade highs; soft jobs data trimmed odds of another Fed hike.
UK 30-year gilt yield crossed 6% on 1 Oct for the first time since 1998.
G7 pledged extra oil supply; Aramco warns stockpile refill could take two years.
